Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit…
I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame…
Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts…
Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”
If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

translations.web: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
translations.bsb: If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn to him the other also. And if someone takes your cloak, do not withhold your tunic as well.
translations.kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
translations.asv: To him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and from him that taketh away thy cloak withhold not thy coat also.
